name: EV-Flying
val_rule: official train split stratified by recording duration (120/180/300 s); within each stratum ids sorted, about 20% taken at evenly spaced positions; 300 s recordings kept for training; fixed before any model result
source: Magrini et al., EV-Flying, CVPRW 2025 (arXiv 2506.04048); HuggingFace GabrieleMagrini/Ev-Flying
labels: per-event, derived from manual 30 Hz boxes; id -1 / class 0 = background; tracks shorter than 99 ms unlabelled
notes: extra_drone = FRED extract distributed separately by the authors; not part of the main protocol
